name: Sono Natsu wa Nidome no Seishun o
original_name: その夏は二度目の青春を
source:
That summer, an author Yuizaki Nagisa received news of a death. Her beloved younger brother Kaede had passed away due to an accident.

Kaede's death felt unreal. Deeply depressed, her days passed on by. Then one day, Kaede's best friend approached her with a certain request.

He told Nagisa that her brother was a member of his school's theater club and that there was a script he planned to write.
He wanted Nagisa to complete that half-written script.

From that day on, Nagisa threw herself into the high school life that Kaede missed out on. As she went through her high school days for the second time, Nagisa discovered a side of Kaede she never knew.

[Translated from [url=http://magichouse.uh-oh.jp/16sononatu_2.html]The Official website[/url]]
translation:
那个夏天，作家结崎渚收到死讯。她深爱的弟弟枫因事故去世。枫的死亡如同虚幻。渚深陷抑郁，日子一天天过去。某天，枫最好的朋友带着一个请求找到她。

他告诉渚，弟弟是学校戏剧社成员，曾计划创作一部剧本。他希望渚完成那份写到一半的剧本。

从那天起，渚投身于枫错过的高中生活。第二次度过高中岁月时，她发现了从未了解过的枫。

[译自[url=http://magichouse.uh-oh.jp/16sononatu_2.html]官方网站[/url]]
